description: EU import measures (TARIC) for a goods code from a given origin country into an EU member state, from the European Commission's Access2Markets tariff service: third-country duty, tariff preferences, anti-dumping/countervailing duties with additional codes, suspensions, supplementary units, conditions and footnotes, with start/end dates and regulation IDs.
